title: Microplastic fiber diet—Fiber-supplemented pellets for small fish
author: Rebelein, Focken

steps.title: Wash and prepare polyester wool
steps.instruction: Wash the pink‑red commercial polyester wool (Kuschelgarn, JES Collection, Germany) with water then ethanol to remove external dirt; moisten the garment with ethanol before cutting.

steps.title: Cut wool into small fibers
steps.instruction: Manually cut the ethanol‑moistened wool with scissors over a petri dish containing filtered ethanol for 45–60 min per section (≈29.8 cm/292.2 mg per section), allowing the released fibers (≈159.5 mg) to stick to the dish.

steps.title: Size‑select fibers by sieving
steps.instruction: Sieve the cut pieces twice through a 300 µm metal sieve, then collect the fibers that pass through a 25 µm metal sieve (Retsch, Germany) using pre‑filtered ethanol.

steps.title: Dry and store fibers
steps.instruction: Flush the collected fibers with ethanol into glass petri dishes, loosely cover with aluminum foil and evaporate ethanol overnight in a fume hood; collect the dried fibers with a metal spatula and store them in aluminum screw‑capped glass tubes (schuett‑biotec, Germany).

steps.title: Prepare fiber suspension for diet
steps.instruction: Weigh the required amount of dried fibers for 50 g of feed (0.01 g for 0.2 mg g⁻¹ diet or 0.1 g for 2 mg g⁻¹ diet) on an analytical balance (Sartorius, Germany); suspend the fibers in pre‑filtered ethanol in a glass vial, transfer the suspension to a WMF metal mixing beaker (63.6 cm² bottom) and rinse the vial twice with ethanol to transfer all fibers. Do not exceed 150 mg fibers or 50–100 g feed per batch with this beaker.

steps.title: Evaporate ethanol from suspension
steps.instruction: Leave the beaker loosely covered with aluminum foil in the fume hood overnight to evaporate ethanol completely.

steps.title: Mix fibers with powdered feed
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate amount of fine powdered fish feed (Essence, Alltech Coppens, Netherlands; grain size 0.2–0.3 mm; 1 g feed per 0.2 mg or 2 mg fibers) onto the dried fiber layer and blend thoroughly with a commercial blender.

substeps.instruction: Add powdered feed to dried fibers

steps.title: Add water to form dough
steps.instruction: Add deionized water to the blended dry mass to achieve a 43 % (v/w) water content (21.5 ml water for 50 g feed) and mix until a homogeneous dough forms.

steps.title: Extrude dough into strings
steps.instruction: Load the dough into a mechanical press (“Sugar paste extruder”, LIHAO, China) and extrude 1 mm‑diameter feed strings.

steps.title: Dry feed strings
steps.instruction: Place the extruded strings in the fume hood, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and dry overnight.

steps.title: Crush and sieve pellets
steps.instruction: Manually crush the dried strings with a chopping knife into 1–5 mm pellets; sieve the pellet mix through a 0.6 mm mesh to discard powder and fragments smaller than 0.6 mm.
